lcc_sn: 永恆主<WH03068>上帝<WH0430>就使<WH05307><WTH8686>{<WAH05921>}那人<WH0120>瞇瞇沉睡<WH08639>；當那人睡覺<WH03462><WTH8799>的時候，永恆主上帝就取下了<WH03947><WTH8799>他的一<WH0259>條肋骨<WAH04480><WH06763>，又用肉<WH01320>去補而合起來<WH05462><WTH8799>{<WAH08478>}。
lcc_original: 永恆主上帝就使那人瞇瞇沉睡；當那人睡覺的時候，永恆主上帝就取下了他的一條肋骨，又用肉去補而合起來。
notes: LCC repeats 永恆主上帝 in the temporal clause (當那人睡覺的時候，永恆主上帝就取下了) as a stylistic expansion; the second occurrence has no Hebrew counterpart and is left unannotated.
瞇瞇 is LCC's descriptive elaboration of the deep sleep and has no Hebrew equivalent; WH08639 (תרדמה) attaches to 沉睡 only.
{<WAH05921>} (עַל, 'upon') kept implicit — LCC renders no explicit word for it, matching UNV's implicit treatment.
LCC restructures the second clause into a temporal subordinate clause (當那人睡覺的時候); WH03462/WTH8799 attach to 睡覺 in that clause.
去補 is LCC's addition describing the patching/filling action; WH05462/WTH8799 (סגר, close up) attach to 合起來 only.
{<WAH08478>} (תחתנה, 'in its place') kept implicit — no explicit LCC equivalent.
